props.title: What Is a Virgin Coconut Oil Massage?
props.text: A virgin coconut oil massage is a relaxing full-body massage with cold-pressed coconut oil, which keeps your skin soft while your muscles relax. The oil is pressed from fresh coconuts without high heat, so it keeps its natural qualities; it glides smoothly and suits most skin types.
props.feature1Text: Retains the natural qualities of fresh coconut through minimal processing.
props.feature2Text: Lightweight, nourishing, and suitable for most skin types.

props.title: Session Duration & Pricing
props.text: Choose 1, 1.5 or 2 hours. Every session uses pure cold-pressed coconut oil, and longer sessions give more time for tired muscles.

props.title: Why Virgin Coconut Oil Works So Well for Massage
props.text: Its smooth texture lets your therapist work in long, unbroken strokes, and it leaves your skin soft and moisturised. What that means during your massage:

Helps reduce friction on the skin

items.question: How is virgin cold-pressed coconut oil different from regular massage oil?
items.answer: Virgin cold-pressed coconut oil is made from fresh coconuts without high heat, which helps preserve its natural composition. Many people prefer it to regular massage oil because it feels lightweight on the skin, gives natural moisture and supports smooth, flowing strokes. Spa Bali Moon uses it for its full-body coconut oil massage in Seminyak.

items.question: Is a coconut oil massage suitable for sensitive skin?
items.answer: For most people, yes. Virgin coconut oil is generally well tolerated and comfortable on most skin types. If you have a coconut allergy or specific skin concerns, please tell Spa Bali Moon before your appointment, for example when you book on WhatsApp. The pressure of the coconut oil massage can also be adjusted to suit you.

items.question: Will a coconut oil massage leave my skin oily?
items.answer: Only slightly. A light layer of oil may remain straight after a virgin coconut oil massage at Spa Bali Moon, but much of the oil is absorbed during the massage, leaving the skin feeling soft, moisturised and comfortable.

items.question: Can I have a coconut oil massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon offers the virgin coconut oil massage as home service at villas and hotels in Seminyak and nearby areas, and your therapist brings fresh linen, the coconut oil and everything else the massage needs. In the Seminyak area, home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist to the treatment price. Mention any coconut allergy when you book.

items.question: Is a coconut oil massage only for relaxation?
items.answer: No. Relaxation is one of its main benefits, but many guests also choose the virgin coconut oil massage at Spa Bali Moon because the oil helps keep the skin feeling soft, smooth and moisturised. It is a popular choice after sun, beach days or outdoor activities, and for guests with dry-feeling skin.

items.question: Is a coconut oil massage good for dry skin?
items.answer: Yes, it can be. Virgin coconut oil massage can suit dry or dehydrated-feeling skin because the coconut oil helps moisturise and soften the skin. Individual skin types can respond differently to oils, so if you have known sensitivities, tell your Spa Bali Moon therapist before treatment.

items.question: Can a coconut oil massage help with muscle tension?
items.answer: Yes, mainly through the massage itself. The techniques used in Spa Bali Moon's virgin coconut oil massage can help tight or tired muscles relax. How much it helps depends on the pressure and technique rather than the oil, and booking 1.5 hours gives extra time for tired muscles.

items.question: How much does a coconut oil massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A virgin coconut oil massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 300.000 for 1 hour, IDR 440.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 580.000 for 2 hours per person. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. We accept Visa, Mastercard or cash, and you can book on WhatsApp.

items.question: How long does a coconut oil massage take?
items.answer: A virgin coconut oil massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 1 hour (IDR 300.000), 1.5 hours (IDR 440.000) or 2 hours (IDR 580.000) per person.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my coconut oil massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your coconut oil massage on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
